Seradon's Mantle of Perception I

Sorcerer · Level 1

Effect

Fills your target's group with power. +14 Intelligence +19 Fire Resist +19 Cold Resist +28 Arcane Resist +13 Shadow Resist +13 Holy Resist +3 Spell Identification Rebalanced except for Int, SR, and HR

Notes

No cost is shown on this tooltip, and none appeared after the player delevelled — unlike the rest of the class, where costs were hidden at one level and visible at another. So this may genuinely have no cost. Worth a developer confirming that is intended rather than a missing value: every other group buff in the game costs something to cast.

Previously recorded by the vgoplayers wiki as: “TGB : INT, Fire resist, Cold resist, Arcane resist, Shadow resist, Holy resist, spell identification” (https://web.archive.org/web/20220517105351id_/https://vgoplayers.com/wiki/index.php/Sorcerer)
